prompt: Create a clean black-and-white pencil portrait illustration of a young woman with a serene expression, facing forward and centered on a plain white background. She has very light blonde rendered as pale graphite lines, long flowing hair parted in the middle, cascading over both shoulders with many fine individual strand lines and soft wave texture. Her face is softly oval with symmetrical features, large almond-shaped eyes, defined natural eyebrows, a delicate straight nose, full softly closed lips, a gentle jawline, smooth cheeks, and subtle realistic shading. Show her from the upper chest upward with bare shoulders in an elegant off-shoulder pose, her right hand placed diagonally across her chest with five visible fingers and neatly shaped nails. Use refined graphite line art, thin contour lines, delicate cross-hatching, very light tonal shading, high-key white negative space, polished fashion-sketch realism, and no color. Keep the composition minimal and graceful, with the head near the top center, hair occupying both sides of the frame, and the hand as the only prominent accessory-like element. No text, no jewelry, no background objects, no harsh shadows, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一幅简洁的黑白铅笔肖像插画，描绘一位神情宁静的年轻女性，正脸朝向前方，居中置于纯白色背景上。她拥有 以浅色石墨线条呈现的极浅金色 的长发，中分发型，秀发垂落在双肩，呈现出许多细腻的发丝线条和柔和的波浪质感。她的脸型呈柔和的椭圆形，五官对称，拥有杏仁状的大眼睛、轮廓分明的天然眉毛、精致挺直的鼻梁、丰满且轻闭的双唇、柔和的下颌线、平滑的双颊以及细腻逼真的阴影。画面展示她从胸部以上的部分，双肩裸露，呈现优雅的一字肩姿态，右手斜放在胸前，五指清晰可见，指甲修剪整齐。采用精致的石墨线条艺术、细致的轮廓线、细腻的交叉排线、极浅的色调阴影、高调的白色留白，呈现出时尚素描的写实感，且不含任何色彩。保持构图简洁优雅，头部位于顶部中心，头发占据画面两侧，手部作为唯一的突出元素。画面中无文字、无珠宝、无背景物体、无生硬阴影、无水印。
